temporalIntegrityObservation: Across the actual ordered150-frame sheets, no obvious blank frame, abrupt camera jump, territorial reset, severe shader flash or disappearing unit was observed. Temporal flicker cannot be certified by contact sheets alone.

terrain.improvement: Relief is visibly retained under both faction materials and is more pronounced than old65406.
terrain.gap: Still coarse and embossed versus finer reference terrain; warm/golden relief light lacks the design target's cinematic presence. No true high-detail elevation/photoreal data parity is claimed.

ocean.improvement: Water has deeper blue tones, structured variation and the initial thick cyan coastal band is reduced.
ocean.gap: Deep/coastal differentiation is modest and surface ripples retain a repeated procedural appearance rather than natural rendered sea depth/light.

territoryFrontier.improvement: Uniform winning-purple material removes old double-purple ambiguity; orange/purple remain distinct; real moving boundary advances continuously with a thin local light cue.
territoryFrontier.gap: Reference's finer irregular edge and the design target's stronger restrained luminous effect are not fully reproduced. The local boundary cue is subtle at mobile scale.

camera.improvement: Saved measured pan/zoom/relative6degree rotation is visually coherent through all150 ordered frames; no gratuitous new motion appears.
camera.gap: Camera/source registration and coastline detail are approximate; no exact footage parity is inferred from unchanged keyframes or technical checks.

units.improvement: Eight original full-body infantry icons replace recognizable source flags/badges. No speculative planes/explosions/smoke were introduced.
units.gap: Actual visible silhouette is small against the textured map, with weak faction-panel separation at mobile size; the design target's dimensional presence is not reached.
